content.title: When is the Masters Golf Tournament in 2026?
content.text: What are the dates for the Masters Golf Tournament in 2025? The 90th Masters Golf Tournament will be held Thursday April 9th through Sunday April 12th, 2026. The practice rounds, which patrons can attend, will begin on Monday April 6th. The practice rounds conclude on Wednesday April 8th with the Par-3 Contest. This event is one of the most beloved elements of the tournament by patrons and players for the wholesome, family-fun nature it adds to the competition. Need a place to stay?
